title: stillingia tenella
intro: Stillingia tenella, commonly known as yellowroot, is a perennial plant native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various inflammatory conditions and skin issues due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and antibacterial agent. The bioactive constituents of Stillingia tenella include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and safety for human use.
